photo_workspace_checks.scope: Isolated Chromium profile; synthetic PNG fixtures only. Multi-batch imports, durable browser storage, SHA-256 deduplication, paging, metadata, unsaved-draft and pending-write navigation protection, preview URL cleanup, same-plane estimates, export, deletion, invalid files, quota failure, and responsive layout. This is not a 3D reconstruction or real-object accuracy benchmark.

photo_transfer_checks.scope: Synthetic PNGs in isolated Chromium contexts. Actual OPFS folder writes through a substituted native picker, physical fixture extraction, directory-input restore into a separate browser context, metadata and byte fidelity, keep-existing duplicates, malformed/incomplete/tampered backups, cancellation, quota failure, unavailable picker, responsive controls, and deterministic controller races. Native operating-system folder chooser interaction is not exercised.
